info.title: Voucherify Loyalty v2 API
info.description:
Complete OpenAPI specification for the Voucherify Loyalty v2 API.
All endpoints require the LOYALTY_V2 feature flag.

Combined from per-domain specs: programs.yaml, members.yaml, program-operations.yaml, card-definitions.yaml, earning-rules.yaml, tier-structures.yaml, benefits.yaml, rewards.yaml, examine.yaml

tags.name: Programs
tags.description: Loyalty program CRUD, lifecycle management, program-scoped resource assignments (card definitions, earning rules, rewards, tier structures), member management (create, list, get, activate, deactivate, delete), membership retrieval (member + program + cards with tier progress, by customer ID, customer source ID, or member ID), card operations (points adjustment, pending points, expiring points, transactions), reward purchases, and activity history.

tags.name: Card Definitions
tags.description: CRUD operations, lifecycle management, and activity history for card definitions. Card definitions describe the configuration for loyalty cards, including code generation, points expiration, earning/spending limits, pending points, refunds, and balance settings.

tags.name: Earning Rules
tags.description: Manage earning rules that define how customers earn points or receive incentives based on triggers (events, segments, custom events). Includes CRUD, lifecycle, and activity history.

tags.name: Tier Structures
tags.description: CRUD operations, lifecycle management, and activity history for tier structures. Includes nested tier definitions (create, list, update, delete) within tier structures. Tier structures define the tiering model for loyalty programs — how members qualify for and move between tiers.

tags.name: Benefits
tags.description: Manage benefit definitions (fixed points, proportional points, material, digital). Includes CRUD, lifecycle transitions, and activity history.

tags.name: Rewards
tags.description: CRUD, lifecycle operations, and activity history for reward definitions. Rewards can be material (product/SKU) or digital (discount coupons, gift vouchers).

tags.name: Examine
tags.description: Evaluation endpoints that estimate earning opportunities and reward availability for a customer across their loyalty program memberships, without side effects.

Enrolls a customer as a member of the loyalty program. The program must be in `ACTIVE` status (returns a `423` error otherwise) and the customer must exist in Voucherify. A customer can be a member of a given program only once - creating a second member for the same customer ID returns `409` error (`member_already_exists`).

Loyalty cards are created automatically for all card definitions assigned to the program and returned in the `cards` array. Card `code` generation is asynchronous: `code` may be `null` immediately after creation.

post.description:
Schedules asynchronous batch creation of program members. The request body is a JSON array of member entries (maximum body size is 10 MB). The request is processed asynchronously in batches of 100 entries.

The program must exist (otherwise, it returns a `404` error) and be in `ACTIVE` status (otherwise, it returns a `423` error). Supported member fields are validated during background processing using the same domain validation rules as single member creation. Entries that fail validation (missing/invalid `customer_id`, unknown customer, invalid `status`, duplicate `customer_id` within the same batch, member already exists) are reported per-entry  individually in the report linked from the async action result. The failed entries do not fail the whole batch (conflicting members are skipped).

Returns `202` status with the identifier of the scheduled async action. Use the [GET Async Action](/api-reference/async-actions/get-async-action) endpoint to check the status of the batch creation. You can also check the processing status and the result in the Audit log – [Background tasks](/analyze/audit-logs#background-tasks) in the Voucherify dashboard.

CardTransactionDetails.description:
Card transaction details. `reason`, `rejection` and `metadata` are present on all variants; the remaining fields depend on the transaction `type`:

- `ADMIN_CREDIT`: `points` (`total`, `expiration_date`)
- `ADMIN_DEBIT`: `points` (`total`)
- `ADMIN_POINTS_EXPIRATION`: `bucket` (the expired points bucket)
- `POINTS_EARNED`: `points` (`total`, `expiration_date`)
- `POINTS_EXPIRED`: `points` (`total`), `date`, `buckets`
- `POINTS_SPENT_ON_REWARD`: `points` (`total`), `reward`, `reward_transaction`,`target_card`, `purchase_transaction`
- `POINTS_PURCHASED`: `points` (`total`, `expiration_date`, `expiration_type`), `reward`, `reward_transaction`, `card_transaction`
- `POINTS_PURCHASE_REVERSED`: `points` (`total`, `expiration_date`,
  `expiration_type`), `reward`, `purchase`, `reward_transaction`
- `POINTS_SPENT_ON_ORDER`: `points` (`total`), `order`, `order_transaction`
- `POINTS_REFUNDED`: `points` (`total`)
- `POINTS_RETURNED`: `points` (`total`, `expiration_date`, `expiration_type`), `reward`, `purchase`, `reward_transaction`
- `PENDING_POINTS_ADDED` / `PENDING_POINTS_ACTIVATED` / `PENDING_POINTS_CANCELED`: `points` (`total`, `date`, `type`)

CardDefinitionCreateRequest.description:
Request body for creating a card definition.
Cross-field rules apply: `balance_settings.allow_negative: true` requires
`points_expiration.type` to be `NO_EXPIRATION`; the earned points refund mode
`REVOKE_BELOW_ZERO` requires `allow_negative: true`; and the earned points refund
method `REVOKE_FROM_PENDING` requires `pending_points.type` to be `PERIOD_BASED`,
`FIXED_DATES` or `EVENT_BASED`.

type.description: Card definition type. Currently only `INDIVIDUAL` is supported.

status.description: Initial status. Allowed values on create are `DRAFT` and `ACTIVE`. Defaults to `DRAFT` when omitted.

code_config.description: Card code generation configuration. Defaults to a 10-character alphanumeric pattern.

pending_points.description: Pending points activation policy. Defaults to `IMMEDIATE`.

earning_limits.description: Points earning limits. Defaults to `NO_LIMIT` for both global and transaction limits.

spending_limits.description: Points spending limits. Defaults to `NO_LIMIT` for both global and transaction limits.

refunds.description: Refund handling configuration. Defaults to `NONE` for both spent and earned points.

balance_settings.description: Card balance settings. Defaults to `allow_negative: false`.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata attached to the card definition.

CardDefinitionUpdateRequest.description:
Request body for updating a card definition.
All properties are optional. `type` and `status` cannot be updated.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata attached to the card definition.

CardDefinitionCodeConfigInput.description:
Card code generation configuration.
When `pattern` is provided, the effective code length is the number of `#`
placeholders in the pattern; otherwise `length` (default 10) `#` placeholders are used.

length.description:
Number of generated characters in the code (ignored when `pattern` is provided).
A positive integer. Defaults to 10.

charset.description: Characters used for code generation. Defaults to alphanumeric: `0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ`.

prefix.description: Fixed prefix prepended to every generated code. Defaults to an empty string.

postfix.description: Fixed postfix appended to every generated code. Defaults to an empty string.

pattern.description: Code pattern where each `#` is replaced with a random character from the charset, e.g. `###-###`. Defaults to `#` repeated `length` times.

CardDefinitionPointsExpirationInput.description:
Points expiration policy.
Conditional requirements based on `type`:
- `NO_EXPIRATION`: `rolling_expiration`, `calendar_expiration` and `sliding_expiration` must be null/absent.
- `ROLLING_EXPIRATION`: `rolling_expiration` is required; the other two must be null/absent.
- `CALENDAR_EXPIRATION`: `calendar_expiration` is required; the other two must be null/absent.
- `SLIDING_EXPIRATION`: `sliding_expiration` is required; the other two must be null/absent.

rolling_expiration.description: Rolling expiration configuration. Required when `type` is `ROLLING_EXPIRATION`, must be null otherwise.

calendar_expiration.description: Calendar expiration configuration. Required when `type` is `CALENDAR_EXPIRATION`, must be null otherwise.

sliding_expiration.description: Sliding expiration configuration. Required when `type` is `SLIDING_EXPIRATION`, must be null otherwise.

CardDefinitionPointsExpirationRollingExp.description: Rolling expiration configuration - points expire after a fixed period from earning.

rounding.description: Optional rounding applied to the calculated expiration date.

CardDefinitionPointsExpirationRollingExp.description:
Rolling expiration period. The maximum `value` depends on `unit`:
1-90 for `DAY`, 1-12 for `MONTH`, 1-5 for `YEAR` (enforced via if/then conditions).

value.description: Period length. Maximum: 90 for `DAY`, 12 for `MONTH`, 5 for `YEAR`.

CardDefinitionPointsExpirationRollingExp.description:
Rounding of the rolling expiration date. When `type` is `END_OF_PARTICULAR_MONTH`,
`value` (month number 1-12) is required; for all other types `value` must be null/absent.

value.description: Month number (1-12). Required when `type` is `END_OF_PARTICULAR_MONTH`, must be null otherwise.

CardDefinitionPointsExpirationCalendarEx.description: Calendar expiration configuration - points expire on fixed calendar dates.

expiration_dates.description: List of calendar dates on which points expire (1-20 dates).

CardDefinitionPointsExpirationCalendarEx.description:
A calendar date (day + month). The maximum `day` depends on `month`
(enforced via if/then conditions): 29 for February, 30 for April/June/September/November,
31 for the remaining months.

day.description: Day of the month. Maximum depends on the month: 29 for February, 30 for April, June, September, November, 31 otherwise.

CardDefinitionPointsExpirationSlidingExp.description:
Sliding expiration configuration - points expiration slides on member activity.
At least one of `earning_activity`, `spending_activity` or `custom_activity` must be `true`.
When `custom_activity` is `true`, `custom_activity_types` is required with 1-10 unique
custom event schema IDs.

earning_activity.description: Whether earning points resets the expiration window.

spending_activity.description: Whether spending points resets the expiration window.

CardDefinitionPendingPointsInput.description:
Pending points activation policy.
Conditional requirements based on `type`:
- `IMMEDIATE`: `period_based`, `fixed_dates` and `event_based` must be null/absent.
- `PERIOD_BASED`: `period_based` is required; the other two must be null/absent.
- `FIXED_DATES`: `fixed_dates` is required; the other two must be null/absent.
- `EVENT_BASED`: `event_based` is required; the other two must be null/absent.

type.description: Pending points activation type. `IMMEDIATE` means no pending period.

period_based.description: Period-based activation. Required when `type` is `PERIOD_BASED`, must be null otherwise.

fixed_dates.description: Fixed-dates activation. Required when `type` is `FIXED_DATES`, must be null otherwise.

event_based.description: Event-based activation. Required when `type` is `EVENT_BASED`, must be null otherwise.

CardDefinitionPendingPointsPeriodBasedIn.description: Period-based pending points activation - points activate after a fixed period.

CardDefinitionPendingPointsPeriodBasedPe.description:

1-90 for `DAY`, 1-12 for `MONTH`, 1-1 for `YEAR` (enforced via if/then conditions).

value.description: Period length. Maximum: 90 for `DAY`, 12 for `MONTH`, 1 for `YEAR`.

CardDefinitionPendingPointsFixedDatesInp.description: Fixed-dates pending points activation - points activate on fixed calendar dates.

dates.description: List of calendar dates on which pending points activate (1-20 dates).

CardDefinitionPendingPointsFixedDatesDat.description:
A calendar date (day + month). The maximum `day` depends on `month`
(enforced via if/then conditions): 29 for February, 30 for April/June/September/November,
31 for the remaining months.

day.description: Day of the month. Maximum depends on the month: 29 for February, 30 for April, June, September, November, 31 otherwise.

CardDefinitionPendingPointsEventBasedInp.description: Event-based pending points activation - points activate when one of the configured custom events occurs, or are cancelled after the cancel period.

event_types.description: Custom event schema IDs (pattern `^ms_[a-zA-Z0-9]+`) that activate pending points. 1-10 unique items.

CardDefinitionPendingPointsEventBasedCan.description:
Period after which non-activated pending points are cancelled. The maximum `value`
depends on `unit`: 1-90 for `DAY`, 1-12 for `MONTH`, 1-1 for `YEAR`
(enforced via if/then conditions).

value.description: Period length. Maximum: 90 for `DAY`, 12 for `MONTH`, 1 for `YEAR`.

empty or `null`; when `type` is `LIMITED`, `limits` must contain exactly 1 limit.

CardDefinitionSpendingLimitsGlobalLimitI.description:
A global spending limit, discriminated by `type`:

oneOf.description: Spending-based limit - at most `max` points can be spent in total.
Time-based limit - at most `points.max` points can be spent per period.

CardDefinitionSpendingLimitsGlobalTimeBa.description:
Time-based spending limit period. When `type` is `CURRENT_PERIOD` (the only
allowed value), `current_period` is required.

type.description: Period type. Currently only `CURRENT_PERIOD` (current calendar period) is supported.

CardDefinitionSpendingLimitsTransactions.description:
Per-transaction spending limits. When `type` is `NO_LIMIT`, `limits` must be
empty or `null`; when `type` is `LIMITED`, `limits` must contain exactly 1 limit.

limits.description: Limit definitions. Empty/null when `type` is `NO_LIMIT`; exactly 1 item required when `type` is `LIMITED`.

oneOf.description: Points limit - at most `max` points can be spent in a single transaction.

must contain exactly 1 method.

CardDefinitionListFilters.description:
Filters for the card definitions list endpoint. Each field accepts a
`conditions` object; provided conditions must be valid for the field type.

junction.description: Logical junction between field filters. Defaults to `AND`.

status.description: Filter by card definition status (`ACTIVE` or `DRAFT` only).

created_at.description: Filter by creation date.

CardDefinitionIdFilter.description:
ID field filter. Allowed conditions:
`$is`, `$is_not`, `$in`, `$not_in`. Values must match the card definition ID pattern
`^lcdef_[a-f0-9]+$`. `$is`/`$is_not` accept a single value (string or 1-element array);
`$in`/`$not_in` accept 1-100 values.

$is.description: ID equals the given value.

$is_not.description: ID does not equal the given value.

$in.description: ID is one of the given values (up to 100).

$not_in.description: ID is none of the given values (up to 100).

CardDefinitionStringFilter.description:
String field filter. Allowed conditions: `$is`, `$is_not`, `$contains`, `$not_contain`,
`$starts_with`, `$ends_with`, `$in`, `$not_in`, `$has_value`, `$is_unknown`.
Single-value conditions accept a string or a 1-element array; `$in`/`$not_in`
accept 1-10 values; `$has_value`/`$is_unknown` are presence checks and ignore the value.

$is.description: Value equals the given string.

$is_not.description: Value does not equal the given string.

$not_contain.description: Value does not contain the given substring.

$starts_with.description: Value starts with the given prefix.

$ends_with.description: Value ends with the given suffix.

$in.description: Value is one of the given strings (up to 10).

$not_in.description: Value is none of the given strings (up to 10).

$has_value.description: Field has a value (presence check; the provided value is ignored).

$is_unknown.description: Field has no value (presence check; the provided value is ignored).

CardDefinitionTypeFilter.description:
Enum field filter for the card definition `type` field. Allowed conditions:
`$is`, `$is_not`, `$in`, `$not_in`.
Values must be one of: `INDIVIDUAL`.

$is.description: Type equals the given value.

$is_not.description: Type does not equal the given value.

$in.description: Type is one of the given values (up to 10).

$not_in.description: Type is none of the given values (up to 10).

CardDefinitionStatusFilter.description:
Enum field filter for the card definition `status` field. Allowed conditions:
`$is`, `$is_not`, `$in`, `$not_in`.
Values must be one of: `ACTIVE`, `DRAFT` (deleted card definitions are not listable).

$is.description: Status equals the given value.

$is_not.description: Status does not equal the given value.

$in.description: Status is one of the given values (up to 10).

$not_in.description: Status is none of the given values (up to 10).

CardDefinitionDateFilter.description:
Date field filter. Allowed conditions:
`$before`, `$after`, `$is`, `$more_than`, `$less_than`, `$has_value`, `$is_unknown`.
`$before`/`$after` accept a date string; `$is`/`$more_than`/`$less_than` accept a
non-negative integer (number of days); `$has_value`/`$is_unknown` are presence checks.
Single values may be passed as a string or a 1-element array.

$before.description: Date is before the given date (a date string).

$after.description: Date is after the given date (a date string).

$is.description: Date matches the given value expressed as a non-negative integer number of days.

$more_than.description: Date is more than the given non-negative integer number of days ago.

$less_than.description: Date is less than the given non-negative integer number of days ago.

$has_value.description: Field has a value (presence check; the provided value is ignored).

$is_unknown.description: Field has no value (presence check; the provided value is ignored).

$not_in.description: Activity type is none of the given values (up to 10).

EarningRuleEffectPointsProportional.description:
Proportional points effect - awards points using an "every X gives Y points" formula.
Depending on `calculation_type`, one specific configuration object is required and the
others must be null/absent:
- `PRE_DISCOUNT_ORDER_AMOUNT`: requires `order.amount`
- `POST_DISCOUNT_ORDER_AMOUNT`: requires `order.total_amount`
- `ORDER_METADATA_VALUE`: requires `order.metadata`
- `CUSTOMER_METADATA_VALUE`: requires `customer.metadata`
- `CUSTOM_EVENT_METADATA_VALUE`: requires `custom_event.metadata`
- `PRE_DISCOUNT_ORDER_ITEMS_AMOUNT`: requires `order_items.amount`
- `POST_DISCOUNT_ORDER_ITEMS_AMOUNT`: requires `order_items.subtotal_amount`
- `ORDER_ITEMS_QUANTITY`: requires `order_items.quantity`
The trigger further restricts allowed calculation types:
`customer.order.paid` allows all order/order-items types plus `CUSTOMER_METADATA_VALUE`;
`customer.custom_event` allows `CUSTOMER_METADATA_VALUE` and `CUSTOM_EVENT_METADATA_VALUE`;
`customer.segment.entered` allows only `CUSTOMER_METADATA_VALUE`.

calculation_type.description: How the proportional points are calculated.

card_definition_id.description: Card definition ID (`lcdef_...`) the points are awarded to.

points_expiration.description: Optional expiration override for the awarded points. Nullable.

EarningRuleEffectBenefit.description: Benefit effect - grants a predefined benefit.

every.description: The divisor - every this amount (e.g. in cents) awards `value` points.

value.description: Points awarded per `every` unit.

EarningRulePointsProportionalMetadata.description: "Every X gives Y points" formula based on a numeric metadata property.

every.description: The divisor - every this metadata value awards `value` points.

value.description: Points awarded per `every` unit.

property.description: Metadata property name holding the numeric value.

EarningRulePointsProportionalApplicableT.description: Criterion selecting order items the calculation applies to. Depending on `type`, exactly one of `product`, `sku` or `products_collection` is required and the others must be null/absent.

EarningRulePointsProportionalOrderItemsC.description: Order items based calculation - "every X gives Y points" applied to items matching the `applicable_to` criteria.

every.description: The divisor - every this amount/quantity awards `value` points.

value.description: Points awarded per `every` unit.

EarningRulePointsProportionalOrder.description: Order-based proportional calculation configuration. `amount` is used by `PRE_DISCOUNT_ORDER_AMOUNT`, `total_amount` by `POST_DISCOUNT_ORDER_AMOUNT` and `metadata` by `ORDER_METADATA_VALUE`.

EarningRulePointsProportionalCustomEvent.description: Custom event based proportional calculation configuration (`CUSTOM_EVENT_METADATA_VALUE`).

EarningRulePointsProportionalOrderItems.description: Order items based proportional calculation configuration. `amount` is used by `PRE_DISCOUNT_ORDER_ITEMS_AMOUNT`, `subtotal_amount` by `POST_DISCOUNT_ORDER_ITEMS_AMOUNT` and `quantity` by `ORDER_ITEMS_QUANTITY`.

EarningRuleEffectPointsExpiration.description: Points expiration override. Depending on `type`, exactly one of `rolling_expiration`, `calendar_expiration` or `sliding_expiration` is required; for `NO_EXPIRATION` all three must be null/absent.

EarningRuleEffectPointsExpirationRolling.description: Rolling expiration - points expire a fixed period after earning.

rounding.description: Optional rounding of the calculated expiration date. Nullable.

EarningRuleEffectPointsExpirationRolling.description: Rolling expiration period. The maximum `value` depends on `unit`: `DAY` - 90, `MONTH` - 12, `YEAR` - 5.

value.description: Period length. Maximum depends on `unit`: 90 for DAY, 12 for MONTH, 5 for YEAR.

EarningRuleEffectPointsExpirationRolling.description: Rounding of the rolling expiration date. `value` (the month number, 1-12) is required for `END_OF_PARTICULAR_MONTH` and must be null for all other rounding types.

value.description: Month number (1-12), only for `END_OF_PARTICULAR_MONTH`. Nullable otherwise.

EarningRuleEffectPointsExpirationCalenda.description: Calendar expiration - points expire on fixed calendar dates (1 to 20 dates).
A calendar expiration date. The maximum `day` depends on `month`: 29 for February (month 2), 30 for April/June/September/November (4, 6, 9, 11), 31 for the remaining months.

day.description: Day of month (1-31; validated against the month length).

EarningRuleEffectPointsExpirationSliding.description: Sliding expiration - points expire after a period of member inactivity. At least one of `earning_activity`, `spending_activity` or `custom_activity` must be `true`. When `custom_activity` is `true`, `custom_activity_types` is required (1-10 unique items).

earning_activity.description: Whether earning activity resets the expiration window.

spending_activity.description: Whether spending activity resets the expiration window.

custom_activity.description: Whether the listed custom activity types reset the expiration window.

custom_activity_types.description: Custom activity type names. Required (1-10 unique items) when `custom_activity` is true. Nullable.

EarningRuleEffectPointsExpirationSliding.description: Sliding expiration inactivity period. The maximum `value` depends on `unit`: `DAY` - 90, `MONTH` - 12, `YEAR` - 1.

value.description: Period length. Maximum depends on `unit`: 90 for DAY, 12 for MONTH, 1 for YEAR.

EarningRuleTierRules.description: Tier requirements for an earning. With `NO_REQUIREMENTS`, `any_of` must be null/absent. With `ANY_OF`, `any_of` is required (at least one entry) and the member must be in any of the listed tiers to earn.

any_of.description: Tier structure/tier combinations, any of which satisfies the requirement. Nullable.

EarningRuleTierRulesAnyOfEntry.description: Tier structure with a list of qualifying tiers.

EarningRuleValidityHours.description: Hours during which the earning rule is active. With `ANY_TIME`, `daily` must be null/absent. With `DAILY`, `daily` is required (at least one entry).

EarningRuleValidityDailyHours.description: Daily validity window on selected days of the week.

days_of_week.description: Days of week (0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday). Items must be unique.

EarningRuleTriggerLimits.description: Cooldown and frequency limits applied to the earning rule trigger.

EarningRuleTriggerLimitsCooldown.description: Cooldown between consecutive triggers per member. With `NO_COOLDOWN`, `fixed_cooldown` must be null/absent. With `FIXED_COOLDOWN`, `fixed_cooldown` is required.

EarningRuleTriggerLimitsCooldownFixedCoo.description: Cooldown period. The maximum `value` depends on `unit`: `HOUR` - 24, `DAY` - 90, `WEEK` - 52, `MONTH` - 12, `YEAR` - 1.

value.description: Period length. Maximum depends on `unit`: 24 for HOUR, 90 for DAY, 52 for WEEK, 12 for MONTH, 1 for YEAR.

EarningRuleTriggerLimitsFrequency.description: Frequency limit for triggers per member. With `NO_LIMIT`, `limits` must be null or an empty array. With `LIMITED`, `limits` is required and must contain exactly one limit.

EarningRuleTriggerLimitsFrequencyLimit.description: A single frequency limit. Currently only the `TIME_BASED` variant exists (discriminated by `type`), which requires `period` and `triggers`.

EarningRuleTriggerLimitsFrequencyLimitTi.description: Time-based frequency limit period. Currently only `CURRENT_PERIOD` is supported; when selected, `current_period` is required.
Current calendar period unit for the frequency limit.
Maximum number of triggers allowed within the period.

max.description: Maximum number of triggers per period.

TierStructureCreateRequest.description: Request body for creating a tier structure. No additional properties are allowed.

name.description: Display name of the tier structure. Required.

type.description:
Tier qualification tracking model. `POINT_BALANCE` qualifies members by their
current point balance; `POINT_EARNED` qualifies members by points earned within
a tracking period. Required.

point_balance.description:
Point balance tracking settings. Required (non-null) when `type` is
`POINT_BALANCE`; must be null/omitted when `type` is `POINT_EARNED`.

point_earned.description:
Points earned tracking settings. Required (non-null) when `type` is
`POINT_EARNED`; must be null/omitted when `type` is `POINT_BALANCE`.

expiration.description:
Tier membership expiration settings. If omitted, defaults to
`{ "type": "NO_RETENTION" }`.

downgrade.description:
Downgrade behavior applied when tier membership expires. If omitted, defaults to
`{ "type": "NO_DOWNGRADE" }`.

metadata.description: Free-form key/value object holding custom attributes.

status.description: Initial status of the tier structure. Defaults to `DRAFT` when omitted.

TierStructureUpdateRequest.description:
Request body for updating a tier structure. All properties are optional; no
additional properties are allowed. When the tier structure is not in `DRAFT`
status, only `name` and `metadata` may be updated.

name.description: Display name of the tier structure.

type.description:
Tier qualification tracking model. If provided, the matching tracking settings
object (`point_balance` or `point_earned`) becomes required.

point_balance.description:
Point balance tracking settings. Required (non-null) when `type` is provided as
`POINT_BALANCE`; must be null when `type` is provided as `POINT_EARNED`.

point_earned.description:
Points earned tracking settings. Required (non-null) when `type` is provided as
`POINT_EARNED`; must be null when `type` is provided as `POINT_BALANCE`.

downgrade.description: Downgrade behavior applied when tier membership expires.

metadata.description: Free-form key/value object holding custom attributes.

TierStructurePointBalanceUpsert.description:
Point balance tracking settings. Members qualify for tiers based on the current
balance of the referenced card definition.

card_definition_id.description: Unique identifier of the card definition whose point balance is tracked.

TierStructurePointEarnedUpsert.description:
Points earned tracking settings. Members qualify for tiers based on points earned
on the referenced card definition within a tracking period.

card_definition_id.description: Unique identifier of the card definition whose earned points are tracked.

period.description: Tracking period during which earned points are accumulated.

type.description:
When a tier change resulting from earned points takes effect: `IMMEDIATELY`
or at the start of the `NEXT_TRACKING_PERIOD`.

TierStructurePointEarnedPeriodUpsert.description:
Points earned tracking period. The maximum `value` depends on `unit`: 90 for
`DAY`, 52 for `WEEK`, 12 for `MONTH`, 5 for `YEAR`.

value.description:
Length of the tracking period, expressed in `unit` units. Minimum 1. Maximum
depends on `unit` (DAY: 90, WEEK: 52, MONTH: 12, YEAR: 5).

TierStructureExpirationUpsert.description:
Tier membership expiration settings. Exactly the sub-object matching `type` is
required; the remaining sub-objects must be null/omitted.

type.description: Expiration model for tier membership. Required.

fixed_duration.description:
Fixed duration expiration settings. Required (non-null) when `type` is
`FIXED_DURATION`; must be null/omitted otherwise.

calendar_expiration.description:
Calendar expiration settings. Required (non-null) when `type` is
`CALENDAR_EXPIRATION`; must be null/omitted otherwise.

sliding_expiration.description:
Sliding expiration settings. Required (non-null) when `type` is
`SLIDING_EXPIRATION`; must be null/omitted otherwise.

TierStructureExpirationFixedDurationUpse.description: Fixed duration expiration settings. Tier membership expires after a fixed period.

period.description: Duration after which the tier membership expires.

value.description: Length of the expiration period, expressed in `unit` units. Minimum 1.

TierStructureExpirationCalendarExpiratio.description: Calendar expiration settings. Tier membership expires on fixed calendar dates.

calendar_dates.description: Calendar dates (day + month) on which tier membership expires. 1-20 items.

TierStructureExpirationCalendarDateUpser.description:
A recurring calendar date. The maximum `day` depends on `month`: 29 for February
(month 2), 30 for April/June/September/November (months 4, 6, 9, 11), and 31 for
the remaining months.

day.description:
Day of the month (1-31). Maximum depends on `month`: February allows up to 29;
April, June, September and November allow up to 30; other months allow up to 31.

TierStructureExpirationSlidingExpiration.description:
Sliding expiration settings. Tier membership expiration slides forward on the
configured member activities.

earning_activity.description: Whether point earning activity extends the tier membership.

spending_activity.description: Whether point spending activity extends the tier membership.

custom_activity.description: Whether custom activities extend the tier membership.

custom_activity_types.description:

TierStructureDowngradeUpsert.description:
Downgrade settings. Controls how members are moved to lower tiers on expiration.
When `type` is `NO_DOWNGRADE`, `grace_period` must be null/omitted.

Downgrade model. `MULTI_LEVEL` allows dropping multiple tiers at once,
`SINGLE_LEVEL` drops one tier at a time, `NO_DOWNGRADE` disables downgrades.
Required.

grace_period.description:
Grace period before the downgrade takes effect. Must be null/omitted when
`type` is `NO_DOWNGRADE`.

value.description: Length of the grace period, expressed in `unit` units. Minimum 1.

round_up.description: Whether the grace period end is rounded up to the end of the unit.

ID field filter for tier structure activity ids. Allowed conditions: `$is`,

of strings matching `^lats_[a-f0-9]+$`.

conditions.description: Condition operators applied to the field.

$is_not.description: Matches when the field does not equal the given value.

$not_in.description: Matches when the field equals none of the given values (up to 10).

$has_value.description: Matches when the field has any value. The value of this condition is ignored.

$is_unknown.description: Matches when the field has no value. The value of this condition is ignored.

TierStructureFilterStatusField.description:
Enum field filter for tier structure `status`. Allowed conditions: `$is`,
`$is_not`, `$in`, `$not_in`. Allowed values: `DRAFT`, `ACTIVE`, `INACTIVE`,
`DELETED`.

conditions.description: Condition operators applied to the field.

$is.description: Matches when the field equals the given value.

$is_not.description: Matches when the field does not equal the given value.

$in.description: Matches when the field equals any of the given values (up to 10).

$not_in.description: Matches when the field equals none of the given values (up to 10).

TierStructureActivityFilterTypeField.description:
Enum field filter for activity `type`. Allowed conditions: `$is`, `$is_not`,
`$in`, `$not_in`. Allowed values are the tier structure activity types.

conditions.description: Condition operators applied to the field.

$is.description: Matches when the field equals the given value.

$is_not.description: Matches when the field does not equal the given value.

$in.description: Matches when the field equals any of the given values (up to 10).

$not_in.description: Matches when the field equals none of the given values (up to 10).

TierStructureFilterDateField.description:
Date field filter. Allowed conditions: `$before`, `$after`, `$is`, `$more_than`,
`$less_than`, `$has_value`, `$is_unknown`. `$before`/`$after` accept valid date
strings; `$is`/`$more_than`/`$less_than` accept non-negative integer values.

conditions.description: Condition operators applied to the field.

$before.description: Matches when the field is before the given date. Value must be a valid date string.

$after.description: Matches when the field is after the given date. Value must be a valid date string.

$is.description: Matches by relative value. A non-negative integer.

$more_than.description: Matches by relative value (greater than). A non-negative integer.

$less_than.description: Matches by relative value (less than). A non-negative integer.

$has_value.description: Matches when the field has any value. The value of this condition is ignored.

$is_unknown.description: Matches when the field has no value. The value of this condition is ignored.

BenefitCreateRequest.description:
Request body for creating a benefit. Exactly one type-specific configuration object
is required, matching the `type`; the remaining type-specific properties must be
omitted or `null`.

name.description: Benefit name. Must be unique within the project.

type.description: Benefit type. Determines which configuration object is required.

status.description: Initial status of the benefit. Defaults to `DRAFT` when omitted.

points.description: Fixed points configuration. Required when `type` is `POINTS`, must be null otherwise.

points_proportional.description: Proportional points configuration. Required when `type` is `POINTS_PROPORTIONAL`, must be null otherwise.

material.description: Material (physical product/SKU) configuration. Required when `type` is `MATERIAL`, must be null otherwise.

digital.description: Digital (campaign-based) configuration. Required when `type` is `DIGITAL`, must be null otherwise.

stock.description: Stock configuration. Defaults to `{ "type": "UNLIMITED" }` when omitted.

BenefitUpdateRequest.description:
Request body for updating a benefit. All properties are optional; omitted properties keep
their current values. When the benefit is `ACTIVE`, only `name` and `stock` may be updated.
After the update, the type-specific configuration must stay consistent with the (possibly
updated) `type`.

name.description: Benefit name. Must be unique within the project.

type.description: Benefit type. Determines which configuration object is required.

points.description: Fixed points configuration (for `type` `POINTS`).

BenefitPoints.description: Fixed points effect - adds a fixed amount of points to a card of the given card definition.

value.description: Number of points to add.

card_definition_id.description: ID of the card definition whose cards receive the points. The card definition must exist and be ACTIVE.

BenefitPointsProportional.description:
Proportional points effect - points are calculated from an order amount, order items,
or a metadata property. Exactly one calculation source object (`order`, `customer`,
`custom_event`, or `order_items`) is required, determined by `calculation_type`;
the remaining source properties must be omitted or `null`.

calculation_type.description:
How the points are calculated:
- `PRE_DISCOUNT_ORDER_AMOUNT` - points per every specified order amount before discounts (requires `order.amount`)
- `POST_DISCOUNT_ORDER_AMOUNT` - points per every specified order amount after discounts (requires `order.total_amount`)
- `PRE_DISCOUNT_ORDER_ITEMS_AMOUNT` - points per every specified amount spent on selected products before discounts (requires `order_items.amount`)
- `POST_DISCOUNT_ORDER_ITEMS_AMOUNT` - points per every specified amount spent on selected products after discounts (requires `order_items.subtotal_amount`)
- `ORDER_ITEMS_QUANTITY` - points per every specified quantity of selected products, excluding free items (requires `order_items.quantity`)
- `ORDER_METADATA_VALUE` - points per every specified value in the order metadata (requires `order.metadata`)
- `CUSTOMER_METADATA_VALUE` - points per every specified value in the customer metadata (requires `customer.metadata`)
- `CUSTOM_EVENT_METADATA_VALUE` - points per every specified value in the custom event metadata (requires `custom_event.metadata`)

card_definition_id.description: ID of the card definition whose cards receive the points. The card definition must exist and be ACTIVE.

BenefitPointsProportionalOrder.description: Order-based proportional calculation. Provide the property matching the `calculation_type`.

amount.description: Points per every specified pre-discount order amount (for `PRE_DISCOUNT_ORDER_AMOUNT`).

total_amount.description: Points per every specified post-discount order amount (for `POST_DISCOUNT_ORDER_AMOUNT`).

metadata.description: Points per every specified value of an order metadata property (for `ORDER_METADATA_VALUE`).
Points per every specified value of a customer metadata property.
Points per every specified value of a custom event metadata property.

BenefitPointsProportionalOrderItems.description: Order-items-based proportional calculation. Provide the property matching the `calculation_type`.

amount.description: Points per every specified pre-discount amount spent on the selected items (for `PRE_DISCOUNT_ORDER_ITEMS_AMOUNT`).

subtotal_amount.description: Points per every specified post-discount amount spent on the selected items (for `POST_DISCOUNT_ORDER_ITEMS_AMOUNT`).

quantity.description: Points per every specified quantity of the selected items, excluding free items (for `ORDER_ITEMS_QUANTITY`).

BenefitPointsProportionalEvery.description: Ratio definition - `value` points for every `every` units.

every.description: Unit step (e.g. order amount in cents) for which `value` points are granted.

value.description: Number of points granted per `every` units.

BenefitPointsProportionalMetadata.description: Metadata-based ratio definition - `value` points for every `every` units of the metadata property.

every.description: Unit step of the metadata property value for which `value` points are granted.

value.description: Number of points granted per `every` units.

property.description: Name of the metadata property used for the calculation.

BenefitPointsProportionalOrderItemsCalcu.description: Order-items ratio definition with the list of applicable products/SKUs/collections.

every.description: Unit step (amount or quantity) for which `value` points are granted.

value.description: Number of points granted per `every` units.

applicable_to.description: Products, SKUs, or product collections the calculation applies to.

BenefitPointsProportionalApplicableTo.description:
A single applicability rule. Exactly one of `product`, `sku`, or `products_collection`
is required, matching the `type`; the other two must be omitted or `null`.

product.description: Product reference. Required when `type` is `product`, must be null otherwise.

sku.description: SKU reference. Required when `type` is `sku`, must be null otherwise.

products_collection.description: Products collection reference. Required when `type` is `products_collection`, must be null otherwise.

BenefitMaterial.description:
Material benefit - a physical product or SKU. Exactly one of `product` or `sku` is
required, matching the `type`; the other must be omitted or `null`.

type.description: Whether the benefit is a whole product or a specific SKU.

product.description: Product reference. Required when `type` is `PRODUCT`, must be null otherwise. The product must exist.

sku.description: SKU reference. Required when `type` is `SKU`, must be null otherwise. The SKU must exist under the given product.

BenefitMaterialProduct.description: Product reference for a material benefit.

BenefitMaterialSKU.description: SKU reference for a material benefit.

product_id.description: ID of the product the SKU belongs to, prefixed with `prod_`.

BenefitDigital.description:
Digital benefit - a reward sourced from a Voucherify campaign. Exactly one of
`gift_vouchers` or `discount_coupons` is required, matching the `type`; the other must
be omitted or `null`. The referenced campaign must exist and its campaign type must match
the benefit's digital type.

gift_vouchers.description: Gift vouchers configuration. Required when `type` is `GIFT_VOUCHERS`, must be null otherwise.

discount_coupons.description: Discount coupons configuration. Required when `type` is `DISCOUNT_COUPONS`, must be null otherwise.

campaign_id.description: ID of the GIFT_VOUCHERS campaign the vouchers are sourced from, prefixed with `camp_`.

balance.description: Balance loaded onto the gift voucher.

campaign_id.description: ID of the DISCOUNT_COUPONS campaign the coupons are sourced from, prefixed with `camp_`.

BenefitStock.description:
Stock configuration of the benefit. When `type` is `LIMITED` the `limited` object is
required; when `type` is `UNLIMITED` the `limited` object must be omitted or `null`.

type.description: Whether the benefit has unlimited or limited stock.

limited.description: Limited stock configuration. Required when `type` is `LIMITED`, must be null otherwise.

name.description: Benefit name, unique within the project.

status.description: Current benefit status. `DELETED` appears only in the response of the delete endpoint and in activity snapshots.

stock.description: Stock configuration. Omitted when not set.

points.description: Fixed points configuration. Present only when `type` is `POINTS`.

points_proportional.description: Proportional points configuration. Present only when `type` is `POINTS_PROPORTIONAL`.

material.description: Material configuration. Present only when `type` is `MATERIAL`.

digital.description: Digital configuration. Present only when `type` is `DIGITAL`.

created_at.description: Timestamp of when the benefit was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last update, in ISO 8601 format. Null when the benefit was never updated.

data.description: Benefits matching the query, in the requested order.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Null when there are no more results.

BenefitListCursor.description: Pagination cursor pointing to the next page of results.

next.description: Cursor ID to pass as the `cursor` query parameter to fetch the next page.

expires_at.description: Timestamp after which the cursor expires.

created_at.description: Timestamp of when the activity was recorded, in ISO 8601 format.

group_id.description: ID grouping activities recorded within the same operation.

source.description: Origin of the activity. Omitted when unknown.

benefit_id.description: ID of the benefit the activity relates to.

BenefitActivityData.description: Activity payload containing a snapshot of the benefit at the time of the activity.

user.description: User who triggered the activity. Present for user-originated activities.

api_key.description: API key used to trigger the activity. Present for API-originated activities.

BenefitActivitySourceApiKey.description: API key used to trigger the activity.

app_id.description: Application ID of the API key.

client_app_id.description: Client application ID (for client-side API keys).

data.description: Activities matching the query, in the requested order.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Null when there are no more results.

BenefitListFilters.description:
Filters for the benefits list. Each field accepts a `conditions` object with at least
one condition. Conditions of multiple fields are combined with the `junction`.

junction.description: How conditions of multiple fields are combined. Defaults to `AND`.

id.description:
Filter by benefit ID.
Allowed conditions: `$is`, `$is_not`, `$in`, `$not_in`. Values must match `^lben_[a-f0-9]+$`.
`$is`/`$is_not` accept a single value (string or 1-element array); `$in`/`$not_in`
accept up to 100 values.

name.description:
Filter by benefit name.
Allowed conditions: `$is`, `$is_not`, `$contains`, `$not_contain`, `$starts_with`,
`$ends_with`, `$in`, `$not_in`, `$has_value`, `$is_unknown`. `$in`/`$not_in` accept
up to 10 values; the other value conditions accept a single value (string or
1-element array); `$has_value`/`$is_unknown` are presence checks.

status.description:
Filter by benefit status.
Allowed conditions: `$is`, `$is_not`, `$in`, `$not_in`. Allowed values: `ACTIVE`, `DRAFT`.

type.description:
Filter by benefit type.
Allowed conditions: `$is`, `$is_not`, `$in`, `$not_in`. Allowed values: `POINTS`,
`POINTS_PROPORTIONAL`, `MATERIAL`, `DIGITAL`.

created_at.description:
Filter by creation date.
Allowed conditions: `$before`, `$after` (ISO 8601 date-time strings), `$is`,
`$more_than`, `$less_than` (non-negative integers, number of days), `$has_value`,
`$is_unknown` (presence checks).

BenefitActivityListFilters.description:
Filters for the benefit activities list. Each field accepts a `conditions` object with
at least one condition. Conditions of multiple fields are combined with the `junction`.

junction.description: How conditions of multiple fields are combined. Defaults to `AND`.

id.description:
Filter by activity ID.
Allowed conditions: `$is`, `$is_not`, `$in`, `$not_in`. Values must match `^laben_[a-f0-9]+$`.
`$is`/`$is_not` accept a single value (string or 1-element array); `$in`/`$not_in`
accept up to 100 values.

type.description:
Filter by activity type.
Allowed conditions: `$is`, `$is_not`, `$in`, `$not_in`. Allowed values:
`vl.benefit.created`, `vl.benefit.updated`, `vl.benefit.deleted`,
`vl.benefit.activated`, `vl.benefit.drafted`.

created_at.description:
Filter by activity creation date.
Allowed conditions: `$before`, `$after` (ISO 8601 date-time strings), `$is`,
`$more_than`, `$less_than` (non-negative integers, number of days), `$has_value`,
`$is_unknown` (presence checks).

BenefitIdFilterConditions.description: ID filter conditions for benefit IDs. At least one condition is required.

$is.description: Matches the exact benefit ID. Single value.

$is_not.description: Excludes the exact benefit ID. Single value.

$in.description: Matches any of the given benefit IDs. Up to 100 values.

$not_in.description: Excludes all of the given benefit IDs. Up to 100 values.

BenefitActivityIdFilterConditions.description: ID filter conditions for benefit activity IDs. At least one condition is required.

$is.description: Matches the exact activity ID. Single value.

$is_not.description: Excludes the exact activity ID. Single value.

$in.description: Matches any of the given activity IDs. Up to 100 values.

$not_in.description: Excludes all of the given activity IDs. Up to 100 values.

BenefitStringFilterConditions.description: String filter conditions. At least one condition is required.

$is.description: Matches the exact value. Single value.

$is_not.description: Excludes the exact value. Single value.

$contains.description: Matches values containing the given substring. Single value.

$not_contain.description: Excludes values containing the given substring. Single value.

$starts_with.description: Matches values starting with the given prefix. Single value.

$ends_with.description: Matches values ending with the given suffix. Single value.

$in.description: Matches any of the given values. Up to 10 values.

$not_in.description: Excludes all of the given values. Up to 10 values.

$has_value.description: Matches records where the field has a value. The condition value itself is ignored.

$is_unknown.description: Matches records where the field has no value. The condition value itself is ignored.

BenefitStatusFilterConditions.description: Enum filter conditions for benefit status. At least one condition is required.

$is.description: Matches the exact status. Single value.

$is_not.description: Excludes the exact status. Single value.

$in.description: Matches any of the given statuses. Up to 10 values.

$not_in.description: Excludes all of the given statuses. Up to 10 values.

BenefitTypeFilterConditions.description: Enum filter conditions for benefit type. At least one condition is required.

$is.description: Matches the exact type. Single value.

$is_not.description: Excludes the exact type. Single value.

$in.description: Matches any of the given types. Up to 10 values.

$not_in.description: Excludes all of the given types. Up to 10 values.

BenefitActivityTypeFilterConditions.description: Enum filter conditions for benefit activity type. At least one condition is required.

$is.description: Matches the exact activity type. Single value.

$is_not.description: Excludes the exact activity type. Single value.

$in.description: Matches any of the given activity types. Up to 10 values.

$not_in.description: Excludes all of the given activity types. Up to 10 values.

BenefitDateFilterConditions.description: Date filter conditions. At least one condition is required.

$before.description: Matches records created before the given date. ISO 8601 date-time string, single value.

$after.description: Matches records created after the given date. ISO 8601 date-time string, single value.

$is.description: Matches records created exactly the given number of days ago. Non-negative integer, single value.

$more_than.description: Matches records created more than the given number of days ago. Non-negative integer, single value.

$less_than.description: Matches records created less than the given number of days ago. Non-negative integer, single value.

$has_value.description: Matches records where the field has a value. The condition value itself is ignored.

$is_unknown.description: Matches records where the field has no value. The condition value itself is ignored.

RewardCreateRequest.description:
Request body for creating a reward.
When `type` is `MATERIAL`, `material` is required and
`digital` must be null; when `type` is `DIGITAL`, `digital` is required and
`material` must be null.

type.description: Reward type. MATERIAL rewards deliver a product or SKU; DIGITAL rewards deliver discount coupons, gift vouchers or loyalty card points.

status.description: Initial status of the reward. Defaults to DRAFT behavior when omitted.

validity_hours.description: Hours during which the reward can be purchased. Defaults to `{ "type": "ANY_TIME" }` when omitted or `null`.

start_date.description: Date from which the reward is available. Must be an ISO-8601 compliant date.

end_date.description: Date until which the reward is available. Must be an ISO-8601 compliant date.

material.description: Material reward definition. Required when `type` is MATERIAL; must be null when `type` is DIGITAL.

digital.description: Digital reward definition. Required when `type` is DIGITAL; must be null when `type` is MATERIAL.

costs.description: Point costs of the reward. Each cost defines the points to spend on a specific card definition, optionally guarded by rules.

refunds.description: Refund policy for the reward. Defaults to `{ "type": "NONE" }` when omitted.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata attached to the reward, as a free-form object.

RewardUpdateRequest.description:
Request body for updating a reward.
All properties are optional. When `type` is provided as
`MATERIAL`, `material` is required and `digital` must be null; when `type` is
provided as `DIGITAL`, `digital` is required and `material` must be null.
In ACTIVE/INACTIVE status only `name`, `metadata`, `refunds`, `validity_hours`,
`start_date`, `end_date` and `costs` can be updated.

type.description: Reward type. Can only be changed while the reward is in DRAFT status.

validity_hours.description: Hours during which the reward can be purchased.

start_date.description: Date from which the reward is available. Must be an ISO-8601 compliant date.

end_date.description: Date until which the reward is available. Must be an ISO-8601 compliant date.

material.description: Material reward definition. Required when `type` is provided as MATERIAL.

digital.description: Digital reward definition. Required when `type` is provided as DIGITAL.

costs.description: Point costs of the reward. Include the `id` of an existing cost to update it; omit `id` to create a new cost.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata attached to the reward, as a free-form object.

RewardMaterialRequest.description:
Material reward definition.
`type` is required. When `type` is `PRODUCT`, `product` is required and `sku` must
be null; when `type` is `SKU`, `sku` is required and `product` must be null.

product.description: Product delivered by the reward. Required when `type` is PRODUCT; must be null when `type` is SKU.

sku.description: SKU delivered by the reward. Required when `type` is SKU; must be null when `type` is PRODUCT.

RewardMaterialProductRequest.description: Product reference for a material reward.

RewardMaterialSKURequest.description: SKU reference for a material reward.

product_id.description: Unique identifier of the product the SKU belongs to, prefixed with `prod_`.

RewardDigitalRequest.description:
Digital reward definition. `type` is
required. Exactly the object matching `type` is required and the other two must be
null: `DISCOUNT_COUPONS` requires `discount_coupons`, `GIFT_VOUCHERS` requires
`gift_vouchers`, `LOYALTY_CARD_POINTS` requires `loyalty_card_points`.

discount_coupons.description: Discount coupons configuration. Required when `type` is DISCOUNT_COUPONS; must be null otherwise.

gift_vouchers.description: Gift vouchers configuration. Required when `type` is GIFT_VOUCHERS; must be null otherwise.

loyalty_card_points.description: Loyalty card points configuration. Required when `type` is LOYALTY_CARD_POINTS; must be null otherwise.

campaign_id.description: Unique identifier of the discount coupons campaign to publish a coupon from, prefixed with `camp_`.
Unique identifier of the gift vouchers campaign to publish a voucher from, prefixed with `camp_`.

balance.description: Gift card balance credited when the reward is delivered.

RewardDigitalLoyaltyCardPointsRequest.description: Loyalty card points digital reward configuration.

points.description: Number of points credited to the member's card when the reward is delivered.

card_definition_id.description: Unique identifier of the card definition to credit points to, prefixed with `lcdef_`.

type.description: Whether reward purchases can be refunded.

RewardValidityHoursRequest.description:
Validity hours definition. `type` is
required. When `type` is `ANY_TIME`, `daily` must be null; when `type` is `DAILY`,
`daily` is required and must contain at least one entry.

type.description: Whether the reward is purchasable at any time or only during specific daily windows.

daily.description: Daily time windows. Required when `type` is DAILY; must be null when `type` is ANY_TIME.

days_of_week.description: Days of the week the window applies to, as integers 0-6 (0 = Sunday). Values must be unique.

RewardCostCreateRequest.description:
A reward cost for creation. `spending`
is required. `rules`, when provided, must have between 1 and 10 properties (in
addition to the constraints of the rules object itself).

rules.description: Rules guarding this cost. Only members matching the rules can purchase the reward at this cost. Must have between 1 and 10 properties.

spending.description: Points to spend on a specific card definition. Exactly one entry is allowed.

RewardCostUpdateRequest.description:
A reward cost for update. Same as the
create variant plus an optional `id` referencing an existing cost.

id.description: Unique identifier of an existing cost to update, prefixed with `lrcst_`. Omit to create a new cost.

rules.description: Rules guarding this cost. Must have between 1 and 10 properties.

spending.description: Points to spend on a specific card definition. Exactly one entry is allowed.

RewardCostSpendingRequest.description: Points spending definition for a cost.

points.description: Number of points the member must spend.

card_definition_id.description: Unique identifier of the card definition the points are spent from, prefixed with `lcdef_`.

RewardCostRulesRequest.description:
Rules group for a reward cost. Contains a required `logic` property plus numbered
rule definitions. Every property other than `logic` must be a positive-integer
key (`^[1-9]\d*$`) mapping to a rule definition. At least one rule definition is
required. No other properties are allowed.

logic.description: A logical formula referencing the numbered rule definitions, e.g. `"1 AND 2"`.

RewardCostRuleDefinitionRequest.description:
A single rule definition inside a cost rules group.
`conditions`, when provided, must have between
1 and 10 properties (one per operator). `rules` allows nesting of rule groups.

name.description: Rule kind. `customer.segment` checks segment membership, `customer.metadata` checks a customer metadata property, `member.metadata` checks a member metadata property.

property.description: Metadata property name the rule applies to (for metadata rules).

error.description: Custom error returned when the rule is not satisfied.

conditions.description: Operator conditions for the rule. Must have between 1 and 10 properties.

RewardCostRuleConditionsRequest.description:
Operator conditions for a rule.
Keys must be one of the supported operators; each value is a non-empty array of
condition values (objects referencing other resources, strings, integers or
booleans). Between 1 and 10 operator properties are allowed.

^(\\$is|\\$is_not|\\$in|\\$not_in|\\$les.description: Condition values compared using the operator given by the property name.

RewardCostRuleConditionObjectRequest.description: Condition value referencing another resource, e.g. a customer segment.

id.description: Unique identifier of the referenced resource.

object.description: Type of the referenced resource, e.g. `segment`.

source_id.description: Source identifier of the referenced resource.

message.description: Error message returned when the rule is not satisfied.

RewardListFilters.description:
Filters for the rewards list. Each field accepts an object with a required
`conditions` property. Conditions that are not supported for a given field type
are rejected.

junction.description: How multiple field filters are combined. Defaults to AND behavior.

id.description: Filter by reward ID (ID field type). Values must match `^lrew_[a-f0-9]+$`.

name.description: Filter by reward name (string field type).

type.description: Filter by reward type (enum field type with values MATERIAL, DIGITAL).

created_at.description: Filter by creation date (date field type).

RewardActivityListFilters.description:
Filters for the reward activities list. Each field accepts an object with a
required `conditions` property.

junction.description: How multiple field filters are combined. Defaults to AND behavior.

id.description: Filter by activity ID (ID field type). Values must match `^larew_[a-f0-9]+$`.

type.description: Filter by activity type (enum field type).

created_at.description: Filter by activity creation date (date field type).

RewardIdFilter.description:
ID filter conditions. `$is`/`$is_not` accept a single value (string or 1-element
array); `$in`/`$not_in` accept a string or an array of 1-100 values. All values
must match the reward ID pattern `^lrew_[a-f0-9]+$`.

$is.description: Matches the exact reward ID. Single value (string or 1-element array).

$is_not.description: Excludes the exact reward ID. Single value (string or 1-element array).

$in.description: Matches any of the given reward IDs (up to 100).

$not_in.description: Excludes all of the given reward IDs (up to 100).

RewardActivityIdFilter.description:
ID filter conditions for reward activities. `$is`/`$is_not` accept a single value
(string or 1-element array); `$in`/`$not_in` accept a string or an array of 1-100
values. All values must match the activity ID pattern `^larew_[a-f0-9]+$`.

$is.description: Matches the exact activity ID. Single value (string or 1-element array).

$is_not.description: Excludes the exact activity ID. Single value (string or 1-element array).

$in.description: Matches any of the given activity IDs (up to 100).

$not_in.description: Excludes all of the given activity IDs (up to 100).

RewardStringFilter.description:
String filter conditions. `$is`, `$is_not`, `$contains`, `$not_contain`,
`$starts_with` and `$ends_with` accept a single value (string or 1-element array);
`$in`/`$not_in` accept a string or an array of 1-10 values; `$has_value` and
`$is_unknown` take no meaningful value (string or array with at most 1 item).

$is.description: Exact match. Single value (string or 1-element array).

$is_not.description: Exact mismatch. Single value (string or 1-element array).

$contains.description: Value contains the given substring. Single value (string or 1-element array).

$not_contain.description: Value does not contain the given substring. Single value (string or 1-element array).

$starts_with.description: Value starts with the given prefix. Single value (string or 1-element array).

$ends_with.description: Value ends with the given suffix. Single value (string or 1-element array).

$in.description: Value equals any of the given strings (up to 10).

$not_in.description: Value equals none of the given strings (up to 10).

$has_value.description: Field has a value. The condition value itself is ignored (string or array with at most 1 item).
